scaffold._discoveryPainPoints:
1. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] NetSuite-Salesforce integration failure causing 9-month delay and forcing manual processes (intensity 9/10, stage: Order Processing) ← flagged as binding
2. [TechnologyIntegrationFriction] 90+ Salesforce customizations making standard implementations complex and unstable (intensity 8/10, stage: Customer Engagement) ← flagged as binding
3. [ProcessHandoffFriction] Sales teams losing 3 days per week to admin and meetings due to system inefficiencies (intensity 8/10, stage: Activity Execution) ← flagged as binding
4. [DataSignalFriction] Lack of pre-visit customer intelligence requiring manual information gathering from customer care (intensity 7/10, stage: Pre-Visit Intelligence) ← flagged as binding
5. [IncentiveCapacityFriction] Distributors becoming order-takers instead of proactive sellers due to lack of tools (intensity 7/10, stage: Performance Enablement)
6. [GovernanceRiskFriction] Staff reluctance to use CRM due to system issues preventing activity metric tracking (intensity 6/10, stage: Performance Tracking)
